description: This file defines a PHP class 'Blog' within the namespace 'Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Cms'. It is a controller class for handling blog-related pages in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. The code includes methods for displaying a list of articles, applying filters (search, tag, topic, author), sorting, pagination, and setting page metadata and breadcrumbs.

classes.name: Blog
classes.description: Controller class for managing the display of blog articles, including filtering, sorting, pagination, and metadata management.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method responsible for handling the display of the blog page. It loads languages, models, processes request filters (search, tag, topic, author, sorting, pagination), prepares data for view rendering, sets page metadata, manages breadcrumbs, and handles pagination links.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Method that handles displaying detailed information about a specific blog article, including metadata, breadcrumbs, image processing, comments, and content rendering.
